The ivory harbor trial found no change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Invented learning-garden trial records supplied in the public synthetic fixture
- Reports a recall outcome
- Any year; English

## Exclusion criteria
- Records not present in the supplied fixture
- No recall outcome

## Query log
- 2026-10-07 | Source: supplied synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json, invented-index) | No live backend searches run; records are entirely invented | Hits: 2

## Screening
- All 2 records included at title/abstract stage; 0 excluded.

## Notes
- Claim/source pairs and synthesis wording copied exactly from the fixture for deterministic integrity evaluation; no edits or normalization applied.
The amber garden trial found no change in recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found no change in recall (Vale, 2024).
